title: Silk Road-linked Bitcoin wallets move $3M to new address
summary: The Silk Road-linked wallets still hold about $38.4 million worth of BTC, with millions potentially sitting in other unseized wallets.

title: Key Bitcoin price levels to watch ahead of 2025’s last FOMC meeting
summary: Bitcoin remains volatile ahead of the FOMC, with big overhead resistance at $94,000 in place and several key support levels below.

title: Binance co-CEO Yi He hit by WeChat hack amid growing Web2 risks for crypto execs
summary: SlowMist’s Yu Xuan advised high-profile users to prune contacts, rotate passwords and act fast on alerts to reduce WeChat takeover risks.

title: Animoca, Solv to help Japanese Bitcoin companies generate yield
summary: Solv generates Bitcoin yield through lending markets, liquidity provisioning to automated market maker pools, and participation in structured staking programs.

title: Connecticut can’t take action against Kalshi for now, judge rules
summary: A US judge has handed Kalshi a small win after putting a temporary stop to the Connecticut Department of Consumer Protection’s enforcement action against the company.

title: Make crypto games great again? ‘Trump Billionaires Club’ launches this month
summary: The Trump Billionaires Club demo video on its website appears to feature a digital version of New York, showing a player token using dice rolls to move around a gameboard.

title: Bitcoin FOMO trickles back at $94K, but Fed could spoil the party
summary: Bitcoin surged to $94,625, its highest in three weeks, as positive social sentiment returned, but comments from the Fed on Wednesday could put it back on shaky ground.

title: Trump to begin interviews with Fed chair finalists this week: FT
summary: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent has presented four names to the White House, with the list reportedly including former Fed governor Kevin Warsh and frontrunner Kevin Hassett.

title: Bitcoin firm Twenty One Capital drops 20% on first day of trading
summary: Twenty One Capital came to market with over $4 billion in Bitcoin, but its lack of publicly shared business plans appears to have led some investors to the exit.

title: Vivek Ramaswamy’s Strive to raise $500M to buy Bitcoin
summary: Strive, co-founded in 2022 by American entrepreneur Vivek Ramaswamy, launched a $500 million preferred stock offering to acquire more Bitcoin and Bitcoin-related products.
